learningObjectives: Create and understand Pandas Series and DataFrames.
Select, filter, and transform tabular data.
Identify common operations used to clean datasets.

activities.title: Explore the DataFrame
activities.instruction: Click each DataFrame component to reveal its role.

content.concept: A Pandas DataFrame represents tabular data using labeled rows and columns.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: A two-dimensional Pandas structure for storing tabular data.
A named vertical collection of values representing a feature or field.
A horizontal record containing values for one observation.
The labels used to identify rows in the DataFrame.
A single value located at the intersection of a row and column.

activities.title: Filter the Dataset
activities.instruction: Select the expression that filters rows based on a condition.

content.concept: Boolean conditions can be applied to a DataFrame to select only records that satisfy a required condition.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Clean the DataFrame
activities.instruction: Arrange the common data-cleaning steps in a logical order.

content.concept: Data cleaning involves inspecting records, handling missing values and duplicates, correcting data types, and validating the resulting dataset.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Build a Data Transformation
activities.instruction: Assemble the operations needed to transform a dataset.

content.concept: Pandas supports selecting, creating, modifying, sorting, grouping, and aggregating data for analysis.
